nodes.name: description_label
nodes.text:
Runs one linear synthesis profile for up to two reusable seed or sapling templates. The soil catalyst is also preserved, and generated drops enter the 15-slot output buffer. Any registered coolant is accepted. Its efficiency divides coolant consumption and multiplies processing speed. Speed, Energy, Hyper Processing, and Process Batch upgrades are accepted.

Item I/O:
§9Seed Input§r exposes both template slots.
§bSoil Input§r exposes the soil catalyst.
§1Input All§r exposes seeds and soil.
§cOutput§r exposes the complete output buffer.

Liquid I/O:
§9Coolant Input§r accepts registered UtilityCraft coolants.
